title: IDLES · Dancer
description: A laundromat and its concrete storefront give way to a red-lit band and a doubled vocal close-up.

performance.lyrics: Ah Ah Ah Ah I'm going little feet touch plus hands for the sake we can swing if you prefer so to speak my breath moves your hair in around that's a glance like a pirouette and a sweat i give myself to you as long as you move on the floor Ah it's hip to hip, Ah dance, Ah cheek to cheek, dance, it's hip to hip, dance and cheek to hip to hip, dance, Ah cheek to cheek, dance, Ah dance, to do goddamn mate, so to speak. I can taste the mood in my mouth, like particles of pot -strunk What moves? swing, lights cut from the moves they make, so to speak. Somebody tell me where I go like a goddamn homing dog and give myself to you as long as we move Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah set, hip to hip, Ah down, set, cheek to cheek, dance, dance, count your downs! Cut waves make change, cut circles in my cage. waves make change, circles in my cage. Cut ways, make change, circles in my cage! I'm a dinosaur, you're a dinosaur, let's go! Yes!
